t: Fortress 5Ltr Pine Decking Oil provides effective protection and a beautiful finish for all outdoor timber decking. This fast-drying, water-based solution is perfect for revitalising garden decking, patios, and wooden pathways, offering enhanced resistance against moisture and weathering. The quick one-hour touch-dry and recoat time ensures projects are completed efficiently for trade professionals. Its breathable, water-resistant formula also enhances the natural look of wood with a subtle pine tint. With low odour and an impressive coverage of 12 square metres per litre, this decking oil is a practical choice for durable timber treatment.
